build.beforeDevCommand: while [ ! -d apps/tauri-gui/frontend ] && [ "$PWD" != / ]; do cd ..; done; cd apps/tauri-gui/frontend && npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174
build.beforeBuildCommand: while [ ! -d apps/tauri-gui/frontend ] && [ "$PWD" != / ]; do cd ..; done; cd apps/tauri-gui/frontend && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost; media-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://localhost:5174 ws://localhost:5174; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-src 'none'; worker-src 'none'
